body.en: To multiply fractions, multiply the numerators together and the denominators together: 2/3 × 4/5 = 8/15. 'Of' means multiply: 1/2 of 3/4 is 1/2 × 3/4 = 3/8. To multiply a fraction by a whole number, write the whole number over 1: 3 × 2/7 = 3/1 × 2/7 = 6/7. You can simplify before multiplying by cancelling a common factor from any top and any bottom: 4/9 × 3/8 = (1 × 1)/(3 × 2) = 1/6.
**A recipe needs 3/4 cup of milk. You make 2/3 of the recipe. How much milk?** Multiply: 2/3 × 3/4. Cancel the 3s: 2/1 × 1/4 = 2/4 = **1/2 cup**.
Top times top, bottom times bottom. Cancel common factors first to keep the numbers small.
body.te: లవం × లవం, హారం × హారం. సంఖ్యలు చిన్నగా ఉండటానికి ముందుగా ఉమ్మడి కారణాంకాలను కొట్టివేయి.
